verdict.rationale: Ledgy is an equity management product, so an employee-facing equity portal is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence never documents employees viewing their own grants, vesting progress, strike price, or outcome scenarios. The only participant-facing evidence covers tracking market orders and receiving payouts on the trading platform, which is an adjacent feature and earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an employee, I get my own portal showing my grants, vesting progress, strike price, and what my equity could be worth under different outcomes
